name: Costa Rica
overview:
Pura vida. Hello, thanks, goodbye, and the answer to life itself. Costa Rica has somehow compressed an entire national mood into two words.

The phrase literally gets translated as “pure life”, but what we experienced felt closer to “life sans complications”. Come to Costa Rica for the vibes. Come to Costa Rica to experience, captured best in the cloud forests of Monteverde (and not so much in the capital, San Jose).
